corrections.reason: In the Andemta commentary, L07 gives the first reading 'በብዙ ጻር' (through much tribulation/agony, 4th order ጻ), while L08 introduces the alternative reading ('አንድም') 'በብዙ ጸር' (through many enemies/adversaries, 1st order ጸ with two equal-length legs clearly visible in the image).
The printed glyph has the 5th-order (ኀምስ) loop on the right leg of ሀ ('ሄደው'), not the 3rd-order horizontal foot of 'ሂ'.
The printed glyph clearly shows the 5th-order ring 'ሄ' in 'ሄዱ', which was misread as 'ሂዱ'.
Removed stray ink-bleed mark after the full stop '።' at the end of the Ge'ez verse.
